$comment: Popup configs in DEV (api-dev.deepdots.com, company MAGICFEEDBACK_DEV) used by the native test apps (MF-3244). One popup config per scenario, so each run gets exactly the popups it tests. The public keys are public by design: they are what a customer's app ships with. Both apps read this file at build time. If you change a popup here, change it in the DEV Admin Panel too.
